# InstallPlugin

## Rules
- `InstallPluginInput`: readonly `pluginName: string` (npm package), `config: SpecdConfig`, optional `options?: Record<string, unknown>`.
- `InstallPluginOutput`: readonly `success: boolean`, `message: string`, optional `data?: unknown`.
- Load via `PluginLoader`; `isAgentPlugin` guard required; non-`AgentPlugin` → `PluginValidationError`.
- `InstallPlugin.execute()` calls `plugin.install(input.config, input.options)`; return generic result.
- Unresolvable package → `PluginNotFoundError`; failed guard or thrown `install()` → `PluginValidationError`.
- Delegate prompt initialization, block injection, native asset deployment to `AgentPlugin.install()`.
- Each `AgentPlugin.install()` / `uninstall()` uses `@specd/skills` `renderBaseAgentInstruction`, `injectSpecdBlock`, `removeSpecdBlock`.
- Shared `AGENTS.md` cleanup reference-counted: base `<!-- <specd> -->` block persists until all targeting agent plugins uninstalled.

## Constraints
- No config mutation; CLI persists through `ConfigWriter`.
